data.longBusinessSummary: Saxon Capital Group, Inc. owns rights to produce and sell Energy Glass Solar Architectural glass products. Its electric producing, clear architectural solar glass technology creates electricity from solar, diffused, and ambient light. The company was formerly known as Xsilent Solutions Inc. and changed its name to Saxon Capital Group, Inc. in June 2015. Saxon Capital Group, Inc. was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Scottsdale, Arizona.
